audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Master Yi all seven level-chart rows. The packet chart is Locke, Locke, Locke, Skill, Skill, Master Yi, Master Yi. The prose on the same page already says the opposite of the rows: whys[0] through whys[2] describe Locke bullying you, whys[3] says 4-5 even out, whys[4] calls level 6 a skill window — while win[0..4] all read 'Master Yi'. The full layer's phases were left on a flat 7/10-to-8/10 template.
audit.why: This is the two-layers failure the brief warns about, except both layers are wrong in the same direction and the page's own explanations contradict its own chart. A reader sees 'you win Level 1' next to a sentence saying his poke bullies you.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to the packet chart, with ratings inverted to match and the five affected whys rewritten to explain the row rather than restate the template.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as Yi's window because Alpha Strike supposedly dodges the ult.
audit.why: Purgatory grounds. Grounding shuts off dashes, so Alpha Strike is not an exit from the zone once it lands — the spike belongs to Locke, and the correct play is leaving before he casts rather than reacting after.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, whys[4], spikes[1].text, content.mid, wants.you[1] and report[5].t all rewritten around leaving early.
sources: champ-data/_kits/locke.json grounding flag and Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you four separate times to hold Alpha Strike for the Purgatory drop and dodge it on reaction. It also states outright that anti-heal is optional against him.
audit.why: Grounding denies the dash, so that advice gets a player killed at the execute threshold — the single most dangerous line in my whole slice. And Soul Ignition (W) heals back a portion of the self-damage on an 18s cooldown; Grievous Wounds cuts self-healing exactly as it cuts lifesteal, so it is the item that decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into six fields; report[8].t rewritten to make Grievous Wounds mandatory. Ashen Pursuit (E) named as a 10s auto reset and his only mobility, with the wind-up as the tell.

audit.why: The page already identifies Ashen Pursuit's spent-blink window as the punish, which is right — E is his only mobility on a flat 10s. Numbers added where they fit.

edits.before: Track Locke’s Ritual Nails (Marks): The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds you, so Alpha Strike is not an escape once the zone is down — leave before he casts. His E is a 10s auto reset and his only exit; the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). Soul Ignition (W) heals back a share of its self-damage on an 18s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds is not optional here — it decides every extended trade you take.

edits.after: Level 6 is a skill window - Purgatory grounds you, so leave early and let Highlander force the fight.

edits.before: Your first real answer: Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his R Purgatory totem's killing beat - hold Q for the totem drop, never for the approach.
edits.after: Careful at 6: Purgatory grounds you, so Alpha Strike will not carry you out of the zone - leave before he casts it and never trade near his execute floor.

At 6 it is a skill window: his R Purgatory totem executes you if you commit carelessly, but Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge the totem's beat - save Q for his R, land it, and the all-in flips your way.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out as your resets and ramping attack speed let you farm through the poke and threaten real trades. At 6 it is a skill window: Purgatory executes low targets and grounds you inside it, so Alpha Strike is not an exit - break off before he casts and take the fight outside the zone.

notes: Two serious problems here. First, the whole level chart was a flat template — all seven rows 'Master Yi' at 7-8/10 in both layers — while the packet says Locke owns 1-3 and 4-5 are even, and the page's own whys already said so. Proposed as seven matched pairs plus the ratings. Second, the page tells you four times to hold Alpha Strike to dodge Purgatory; Purgatory grounds, so the dash is denied and that advice kills you at the execute threshold. Also reversed 'anti-heal is optional' — Soul Ignition's heal-back is reduced by Grievous Wounds like any other healing.
